name: The last judgment
summary: The Lich King comes through a portal and strikes Drakuru down. He spares the infiltrator, amused by the deception that has undone his servant. Stefan’s operation has ended the Overlord’s command, but no account here restores the chieftains who were made into Blightblood Trolls or measures what the Scourge had already taken from Zul’Drak. Drakuru’s bargain began with a hand through a cage; it ends above a conquered land, beneath the judgment of the master he chose.
